text:
Alice: Heads-up — SignalForge (acct SF-91) just flipped a new feature to prod for their Recommendations team. We're seeing a steady qps increase from ~60 -> ~380 in 18h, mainly on the `session_embed` route.
Priya: thanks. Procurement flags: they said finance review in ~4w and want a predictable monthly price. could be Dedicated ask if hosted looks unpredictable.
Raj: do we have a per-route caller list? who is spiking?
Alice: looks like two internal services: rec-engine (spike at 9-11am PT) and live-qa (sporadic). sample payload from onboarding form:
```
client_id: SF-91
routes: [session_embed]
avg_tokens: 450
peak_rps: 8
burst_window: 5s
concurrency_pattern: diurnal
```
Raj: ok. short term options: 1) enable session-level KV cache to reduce recompute, 2) bump burst quota for 48h while we tune batching. both low-friction.
InfraOncall: Can approve 48h burst if CS and Sales confirm cost acceptance. opened quota ticket qt-7732.
Priya: I'll draft a renewal/upsell note and flag as "monitoring — potential Dedicated".
Alice: also capture feedback — customer notes higher tail latency when multiple small sessions (<100 tokens) interleave with large sessions. might be batching policy.
Raj: add to regression set: 30 short sessions, 10 mixed-length streams. want alert if p95 increases >20%.
OnboardBot: scheduled enablement: "SignalForge embed tuning" Wed 11:00 AM PT — invite sent. :calendar:
BillingBot: estimate request received (id b-1129) for hosted vs 2-card Dedicated. ETA 24h.
Priya: action list: 1) Raj to test KV caching + batching tweaks (ETA EOD) 2) Alice to monitor qps and send exec summary to SignalForge (ETA after workshop) 3) Billing to post cost compare (ETA 24h). I'll loop in AM on renewal strategy.
Alice: +1. marking renewal_watch and expansion_signal. thanks all. :thumbsup:
